name: agy-first-bridge
description: agy-first bridge for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): prioritize the local agy CLI in every mode (full DSH control, no prompts), with a rate-limit/network fallback dialog, a live status light (dynamic form + home-level plugin), and a zero-dependency MCP server so any MCP-capable agent (Claude Code / Codex / Cherry Studio …) discovers agy itself. Single npm package: install the home-level status light via `dsh plugin --profile web add agy-first-bridge`. v1.6.1 fixed a client-module registration id mismatch; v1.6.2 fixes the MCP→light file path under the merged-package layout.
